name: Santo-Small, TUS-Small, TUS-Large, Santos-Large, WDC-10K, WDC-100K, WDC-1M
description: Data for Distribution-Aware Unionable Table Search (B. Kassaie and R. J. Miller): the seven benchmarks of the paper's Table 2 — Santo-Small, TUS-Small and TUS-Large (effectiveness) and Santos-Large, WDC-10K, WDC-100K and WDC-1M (scalability) — with their query workloads, unionability ground truth, Starmie column embeddings, per-column value-distribution synopses, and the Starmie model checkpoint used to produce the embeddings. Code and step-by-step reproduction instructions: https://github.com/Besatkassaie/DUTS (branch EDBT27). Archives are tar + zstd; archives over 1 GB are split into 1 GB parts (join with cat); MD5SUMS lists the checksum of every joined archive; README.md describes each archive. The benchmarks are derived from existing datasets; please also cite: SANTOS (Khatiwada et al., SIGMOD 2023), Table Union Search (Nargesian et al., PVLDB 2018), the WDC Web Tables corpus (Lehmberg et al., WWW 2016), and Starmie (Fan et al., PVLDB 2023). CC-BY-4.0 covers our contributions (the augmentation, query selections, embeddings, synopses and the model). The WDC-10K/100K/1M tables are samples of the Web Data Commons Web Tables corpus, extracted from Common Crawl; rights in them remain with their original owners.
